$comment: Ovrly contracts 0.2.0-draft. Additive BE-06 polling contract; requires Android/backend review.
title: CaptureStatus
description: Owner-scoped live-capture status. Receipt coverage is not analysis coverage. Open duration is the highest received end; close can declare a longer duration so a missing tail is explicit. Expired open sessions read abandoned with closed_at equal to expires_at. Currently media validation runs incrementally, but ASR/OCR/claim extraction are separate pipeline work: published validation jobs remain waiting, claims stays empty and claim_extraction_status is not_started. Empty claims is not a no-claims finding. Exception: a server running the development-only OVRLY_STUB_REPORTS lists the claims of the capture's fixture report (report.fixture true) here, with claim_extraction_status partial or complete; clients must label those as a fixture, not as live results.

expires_at.description: Creation time plus 180 seconds plus the configured upload-target grace (default 900 seconds). The media timeline itself can never exceed 180000ms. New bytes must finish by this deadline; stored duplicate retries and close remain available afterwards.

reconciliation_progress.description: Interpretation progress, separate from modality coverage and assessment completion.

extraction_progress.description: Optional fixture-backed incremental extraction coverage and cumulative reservations. Absent until an internal producer admits observations; not a declaration that live ASR/OCR is integrated.
